cues.text: Hi there! I'm Orion, and welcome to Orionis Tech.
We're Bangladesh's first AI-first technology company.
We build technology that connects, automates, and scales your business.
Custom software. Websites and mobile apps. And AI automations that keep working while you sleep.
We move you to the cloud, connect your data, and build custom solutions for problems nobody else has solved.
No templates. No generic fixes. Every solution is tailored to how your business really works.
We plan, we build, we scale, and we stay with you to maintain it, for the long term.
Tap the cards around me to explore our work, or tap a service on the ring to watch it come to life.
